title: Reverse image search and map pivots (P260): manual links, never fetched by V3LUM

x_standing_labels.reverse_image: not for identifying people from facial images: use for impersonation, fake-profile and cloned-logo checks within the case purpose

x_notes: Batch p2-G12-1 (P260). Offline data (disclosure 'none'): V3LUM never requests these URLs or any API behind them. Every link is an x_module_links entry rendered by the pivots_geo_image module, because the final conditions need checks the frozen core link model cannot express: public image URLs only (cond 8), no links for images from documents or files (cond 9), the per-link max_tlp (cond 1, 10; stored as x_max_tlp), and lat/lon taken from the normalised coordinates through vetted placeholders (cond 11). Placeholders: {url_q} = the image URL percent-encoded (quote, safe=''), query position; {url_path} = the image URL without its scheme, percent-encoded except '/', whole path; {lat} {lon} = the coordinates value split, fixed 6 decimals. File order is the curated analyst-value order (cond 6): TinEye, Google Lens, ImgOps, Yandex for images; OSM, then Google Maps for coordinates.
